goal: Add opt-in structured-problem transport for canonical gear APIs and a deterministic, dependency-free workbench state model without activating the equipment page.
userValue: The future equipment workbench can preserve backend 409, 503, blocked and pending truth, reject stale responses and separate confirmed choices from drafts before any user-visible page cutover.
nonGoals: No active gear-page consumer or mini-program UI change in Slice 3B
No change to default requestJson fallback behavior for existing callers
No change to existing requestWebsimProfile or requestWebsimGearStats contracts
No backend, database, migration, write, sync, backfill, cleanup, job, Worker, service, timer or deployment change
No local inference of legality, Tier identity, set count, deterministic attributes or profile readiness
No formal Phase 4 Active Season Manifest or release registry
No public baseline, recommendation, DPS comparison or BiS behavior

mustChange: opt-in structured-problem response mode in pages/common/api-client.js
canonical Resolve and Profile client wrappers in pages/builds/websim-api.js
pure pages/builds/gear-workbench-state.js with confirmed/draft, serial/version and read-only state
focused frontend transport and deterministic state tests
mustNotChange: default requestJson behavior, auth headers and analytics headers
active equipment page behavior or storage
backend Resolve/Profile contracts and public observed-only payload
evidenceRequired: TDD proof that valid structured 200/202/409/503 envelopes bypass generic fallback only in opt-in mode
network, timeout and malformed response fallback proof
exact canonical Resolve and Profile request-shape tests
pure immutable state tests for confirmed/draft, serial/version, one revision rebase, offline/read-only and profile gating
targeted Node tests, frontend and full verification profiles, local CR and exact-head GitHub Harness
explicit proof that no active page imports or invokes the dormant state module

ownership.factOwner: backend gear-result-envelope-v1 and Resolved Snapshot remain final-fact owners; Slice 3B owns only transport preservation and pure client state transitions

engineeringHealth.reason: The slice is dependency-free, opt-in and dormant. It adds no active page consumer, network side effect, storage, clock, backend rule, second fact source or deployment surface.

acceptanceEvidence: static active-import inspection and git diff --check

decisionLog.decision: Keep structured-problem handling opt-in so all existing requestJson callers preserve their current fallback contract.
Keep the workbench state module pure and dormant; active page integration, real WeChat evidence and candidate deployment belong to Slice 3C.
Preserve 503 authority unavailable separately from offline transport failure and allow exactly one revision-only 409 rebase.
